title: The Protocol of Sector Nine Anew
author: Freya Almeida
blurb: Beatrix Crane, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
